text: (1) "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" (Template: Nanjing University Foreigner Physical Examination Record, Valid for 6 Months); (2) Bachelor's degree certificate or academic degree certificate (for recent graduates, a pre-graduation certificate can be provided); (3) Complete transcript of all undergraduate courses; (4) Two recommendation letters from teachers with the rank of associate professor or above; (5) HSK certificate (applicants for Chinese language courses must provide it; those who have received 12 years of Chinese education in Malaysia, Singapore, etc. can use their high school graduation certificate instead of the HSK certificate) or TOEFL (or TOEFL Essentials), IELTS, or Duolingo English Test score report (applicants for English language courses must provide it). (6) Personal Statement (Personal Statement Template) (7) Front page of passport; (8) Chinese applicants are required to submit the necessary identification documents as per the requirements. For detailed information, please refer to the list of identification materials for Chinese students. (9) Applicants for the School of Architecture and Urban Planning are required to submit their portfolio of works.
